conditions: The expression uses super in the receiver position of a send inside an executing instance method.
limitations: This describes the starting class and the receiver. The same text distinguishes use of super as an argument and ordinary sends to self.
This is documentation for the exact 1983 edition and is not an execution result.

triggers: Recheck a changed primary source, a corrected edition attribution, or contrary evidence on the exact scope.

statement: In the Smalltalk-80 Blue Book’s account of instance methods, a send to super keeps the same receiver as self and starts method lookup at the superclass of the class containing the executing method.
